newsitem.title: USA: RightChoice names John O'Rourke CEO.
newsitem.headline: RightChoice names John O'Rourke CEO.

text.p: RightChoice Managed Care Inc said it named John O'Rourke chairman and chief executive.

O'Rourke was previously president and chief executive of HealthLink Inc, which was acquired by RightChoice in August 1995. O'Rourke replaces Roy Heimburger, who remains president of parent company Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Missouri.
Norman Tice and Frederic Brussee continue as vice chairman and president of RightChoice, respectively, the company said.
O'Rourke was also named chief operating officer of Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Missouri, of which RightChoice is the publicly held subsidiary.
